name: mcp-osascript
description: Let Claude control your Mac — 18 typed tools for windows, menus, keyboard, clipboard, browser tabs, screenshots, notifications.
long_description: MCP server for macOS automation via AppleScript and JXA. 18 typed tools with input validation and security guardrails. Features self-correcting menu clicks (when Claude picks the wrong menu item, the server returns what's actually there so Claude retries correctly), multi-monitor awareness, screenshot capture, Apple Shortcuts integration, URL scheme allowlist, environment isolation, process group kill, and a check_permissions tool that reports which macOS permissions are granted before an automation is attempted. 84 integration tests, and a third-party security audit of every tool.

tools.name: check_permissions
tools.description: Report which macOS permissions are granted and what each unlocks

tools.name: get_frontmost_app
tools.description: Get active app name and bundle ID

tools.name: get_browser_tabs
tools.description: List tabs in Safari, Chrome, or Arc

tools.name: get_displays
tools.description: List connected displays with position and size

tools.name: app_menu
tools.description: List or click menu items in any app

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture full screen, region, or app window

tools.name: app_visibility
tools.description: Hide, unhide, or quit an application

tools.name: file_open
tools.description: Open a file or folder, optionally in a given app
